title: GSE trace-consistent topology commit capacity

worlds.fit_and_method_selection: 60 procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C01-C06
worlds.development_validation: 20 disjoint procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C07-C08
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10, strict test and all M-TARE benchmark worlds

sampling.independent_unit: procedural world; physical support unit is a directed traversal
sampling.temporal_context: current plus four strictly past observations within the same directed traversal

student_inputs: three frozen GSE exit-token and geometric-semantic outputs
executed traversal identity and causal within-world order
teacher_source: Frozen corrected causal teacher manifest derived from train/development TNG, splines and geometry; teacher identity is excluded from proposal, association and commit decisions.
split_logic: C01-C06 select one proposal threshold; the selected method is applied once to C07-C08. No C07-C08 result may change the method.

leakage_audit.teacher_identity_usage: metrics only after replay is complete

approval_binding.operation: one immutable C01-C08 zero-training trace-commit capacity run
approval_binding.reference: User instructed automatic selection and execution of the best in-scope route without further routine approval prompts.
